negative_snippets:
A Complete Nightmare, Worst Stay Ever

This was honestly the worst hotel stay I’ve ever had. For the prices they charge, they don’t even deliver 1% of the value. The room looked cheap, cramped, and extremely poorly maintained. It seems like they’ve invested only in the exterior because the inside tells a completely different story.

First, the so-called “king-sized” mattress was actually two separate mattresses awkwardly pushed together—uncomfortable and ridiculous. Second, the blanket they provided had green stains on it, which was absolutely unacceptable. Third, there wasn’t even a mirror in the entire room. No extra table, nothing. Even the electric kettle was placed on a tiny foldable bed table with no nearby plug point, you literally have to bring it next to your bed to switch it on.

I usually book Saltstayz properties, and I’m regretting not doing that this time. There is nothing “ELITE” about this place. Don’t fall for the positive reviews; they seem fake or paid. Save your money and your sanit, avoid this hotel at all costs.
